notes.title: Small Updates for December 25
notes.content:
Hello fellow ghouls! 

We just wanted to let you know what’s happening behind the scenes. We’re currently evaluating whether or not to scale the game further. This isn’t just about resources—it’s also about whether it makes sense artistically to invest more of our creative time into expanding this project. We’re also considering, at some point, the possibility of working with external partners, like publishers, who might help broaden the game’s reach. Once we have more clarity on those fronts, we’ll be in a better position to decide how far we should take the game.

Also, we wish you all a Merry Christmas!

[b]Recent Changes[/b]

- Attempted to fix crashes when switching to the main menu. It still occurs sometimes :(
- 12 Achievements are now obtainable.
- Various smaller bug fixes.

notes.title: New Weapon Mechanics and Comprehensive Tutorial Overhaul
notes.content:
In this update, we made a major gameplay change revolving around weapons, which now break after use. Workshops did not have a use in the later phases of the game. The amount of wear on a weapon is determined by the clarity stat. Secondary attacks do not wear out the weapon, making it more appealing to use secondary attacks. Divine weapons won't break and now jump out of the water.

To make the game more comprehensible, we also removed the old tutorial system. It was not sufficient to explain most of the game mechanics. Instead, we created a full tutorial. Skilling also has a short textual tutorial in the main menu, and the level editor now includes tooltips.

Here is the usual full changelog:

- Weapons now break on usage (no throws)
- Weapon breaking is dependent on the clarity stat
- Doubled weapon production time
- Increased church production time by 2 seconds
- Block chance is now determined by the insidiousness stat
- Added tooltips in level editor
- Extra controls tips section
- Skills system tutorial
- Tips are now also in the main menu
- Removed old tutorial
- Improved targeting
- Created a full tutorial

notes.title: Final Phase of Gameplay Updates
notes.content:
Hello, Fellow Ghouls!

We’re in the midst of designing our story mode and making plans to optimize the game. We are approaching what is likely the last phase where gameplay changes can still happen. This makes your feedback incredibly important right now.

We value your input deeply, so please share your thoughts through our feedback system. Whether it’s features you enjoy or areas for improvement, your feedback plays a crucial role.

Cheers!
